name: Meclonazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine related to clonazepam discovered by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1960s. The drug is suspected to be useful in treating schistosomiasis. The drug has been sold on the grey market as a recreational drug but has not seen widespread popularity.
